rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
Ritual / practice (noun) / ceremony — hard ban
No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
Register match.
Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule applies to article surfaces only; this is a module file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
Watch out for planting jargon too early.
Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
The "What happened:" block is OPTIONAL.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing.
A claim binds to every body that states it.
A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 85-86: "Module 6 reads the packaged session... The question changes scale too: Module 5 asked *did my task pass?* Module 6 starts asking *do all our tasks pass, and who reviewed what?*" Harm: closing gestures at rest of training with training/module as subject, not student. Violates rule by addressing reader as recipient of arc-positioning rather than as grammatical subject of next action. Subject test requires student as subject of declarative claim (e.g., "You'll find…", "when this loop has to scale past you"), not training/module.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Rewrite ## Next closer with student as subject: e.g., "You'll build checks that let long runs scale across your whole stack" or similar, grounding forward gesture in what student does, not what module does.
